transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for coming to our pre-planting check-in. As we get ready for the June 1 through June 30 growing season, I want to hear from each of you before I finalize the layout, care plan, and harvest distribution. We've got four raised beds to work with and roughly 40 kilograms of produce expected. Does anyone have plans, constraints, or information I should know about before I start putting the planting plan together?
